Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 1 Purpose of the policy
Pulse is committed to ensuring that the recruitment and selection of all employees is conducted in a fair and transparent manner. Positions offered will based on merit, experience, attitude and competency of the candidate. Recruitment team will be committed to give equal opportunity to everyone and at every step of recruitment process and will not exclude any applicant from being considered for a position based on their background, culture, religion, gender or economic circumstances. No person below 18 years of age shall be employed in the company. The personal and professional information received during the process with will dealt with strictest confidence.

This policy document defines

1.1. The standards of the recruitment and selection process of the company to recruit staff with the appropriate skills, both functional and behavioral, in order to meet the Organization's current and future needs

1.2. Individual responsibilities to ensure transparency and effective implementation of recruitment and selection procedures

1.3. Standard documents to be used during the process

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 2 Scope of the policy
The policy is applicable to all the employees who are involved in the recruitment and selection process of the company. This policy is not applicable to senior post holders as defined in the Articles of Association.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 3 Responsibility
3.1 Hiring Manager is accountable for driving the recruitment process with HR support.

3.2 HR Head and Heads of respective departments will be jointly responsible for implementation of this policy.

3.3 HR is responsible for choosing the right and the most cost effective channel to source the profiles and end-to-end satisfactory closure of the hiring and selection process.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 4 Recruitment Process
Figure: Recruitment process cycle -- the flow moves cyclically: Needs Identification -> Manpower request -> Job description -> Sourcing & Screening -> Interviewing -> Selection -> Job Offer.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 4 Recruitment Process > 4.1 Needs Identification
4.1.1. Manpower needs identification is done every year in March during the yearly budgeting exercise.

4.1.2. HR will prepare the yearly Manpower Budget Plan in coordination with the Business Leaders.

4.1.3. All Business and Functional Heads would forecast the manpower requirement for their respective departments for the next financial year and will share month wise plan indicating the requirement in terms of number of people required, their level and a detailed justification for every position. Factors to be considered while estimating the manpower plan are given below.

a) New products / business expansion

b) Increased responsibilities

c) Process improvements and automations

d) Promotions and transfers

e) Employee separation due to attrition, retirement

4.1.4. The manpower budget plan must be approved by MD, CFO and Head HR.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 4 Recruitment Process > 4.2 Manpower request
4.2.1. All manpower requests must be initiated by the hiring manager (person who needs the manpower) by raising a manpower request form (mrf - annexure 1).

4.2.2. Hod has to ensure that the headcount has been budgeted for - except where a new opportunity / challenge / legal requirement present itself.

4.2.3. MRF approval process is defined below.

4.2.3.1. Replacement vacancies, New Positions and Un-budgeted positions (below AGM)

4.2.3.2. Replacement vacancies, New positions and Un-budgeted positions (AGM & above)

Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 4 Recruitment Process > 4.2 Manpower request
Figure: MRF approval flow. 4.2.3.1 Replacement vacancies, New Positions and Un-budgeted positions (below AGM): Hiring Manager -> Business / Functional Head -> Director -> HR. 4.2.3.2 Replacement vacancies, New positions and Un-budgeted positions (AGM & above): Hiring Manager -> Business / Functional Head -> Director -> MD -> HR Head.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 4 Recruitment Process > 4.3 Job Description (JD)
4.3.1. To ensure a level of equality and fairness, each job/role will have its own job description.

4.3.2. The creation, review and updating of JD will be an ongoing process. Job descriptions will be written by the HR in consultation with the hiring manager and business Heads.

4.3.3. The job description describes the fundamental nature of the job. It should help

4.3.3.1. HR in sourcing right profiles for the role

4.3.3.2. Applicants in clearly understand the job requirements

4.3.3.3. Employees to have clarity on their roles and responsibilities

4.3.3.4. Managers in communicating expectations from the job to the team

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 4 Recruitment Process > 4.4 Sourcing and screening
4.4.1. External Sourcing: Includes sourcing qualified profiles from one or more channels like

4.4.1.1. Job Portals and Social Networking Sites

4.4.1.2. Search Partners

a) Search Partners will be engaged wherever required.

b) Corporate HR would identify right Search Partners, negotiate the Terms & Conditions and will sign a formal agreement with them.

c) No search partner will engaged by HR if the agreement is not signed off.

4.4.1.3. Campus Hiring

a) Campus hiring will be done for entry level positions budgeted in the annual manpower plan.

b) This process will be driven by the HR and HOD.

c) HR will seek support from Administration, travel desk and IT departments as required. HR will take budget and all necessary approvals to execute the plan.

d) Campus hiring process is given below

4.4.1.4. Job fairs

4.4.1.5. Advertising

4.4.1.6. Website postings

4.4.1.7. Postings at Hiring sites

4.4.2. Internal Sourcing: includes sourcing qualified profiles internally within the Organization either through internal job posting or through employee referrals.

4.4.2.1. Internal Recruitment

a) To promote internal career progression opportunities, wherever feasible, preference will be given to existing employees possessing necessary skills, knowledge and experience matching with those required for the job vacancy.

b) An internal job posting (IJP) will be published by the HR along with the JD and interested employees can apply for the job posted.

c) Employee are advised to inform their reporting manager before applying to the job

d) All the applicants will have to undergo formal interview process as laid down in this policy.

4.4.2.2. Employee referrals

a) To improve employee engagement and to create a sense of belongingness, we encourage employees to refer their friends for open role in the company.

b) Employees can share the CVs of their friends with their HR

c) All the applicants will have to undergo formal interview process as laid down in this policy.

d) Referral Bonus will be paid to the employee who has referred, as per BAY - Bring Another You Policy (Annexure 2) of the company.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 4 Recruitment Process > 4.4 Sourcing and screening
Topic: 4.4.3 Screening
4.4.3.1. Screening is an initial assessment of the applicants based solely on the information contained in their application forms/Resume/CV.

4.4.3.2. The purpose is to decide which applicants meet the essential and/ or desirable job criteria so that they may be given more in-depth consideration at the next stage of the process.

4.4.3.3. HR, as required, will conduct a preliminary round of discussion with the applicants and will share the relevant CVs with the Hiring Manager / HOD for further screening.

4.4.3.4. The process of shortlisting by Hiring Manager/ HOD involves slimming down the total number of applications received from recruiter to a shortlist of candidates whom can be considered for detailed assessment phase of the selection process.

4.4.3.5. HR/Hiring Managers/HOD should refer to the JD while screening the CVs.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 4 Recruitment Process > 4.4 Sourcing and screening
Figure: Campus hiring process (clause 4.4.1.3) -- Preparation: travel plan; itinerary for conducting the exam and interview; corporate presentation; test papers / online test; necessary approvals. Conducting: corporate presentation; written/online test (technical and aptitude); technical interview; HR interview; release provisional offer letter. Closure: release the job offer letter; share checklist for joining; stay in contact; prepare induction plan.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 4 Recruitment Process > 4.5 Interviewing
4.5.1. We emphasis on hiring the right talent for the right role. Thorough assessment of the applicant's skills, experience, knowledge, and attitude should be done to check the match with the job requirements.

4.5.2. HR and the hiring manager will be accountable to conduct well-structured interview process and hire new employees efficiently.

4.5.3. The following are the guidelines to be followed by the interview panel consisting of HR, Hiring Managers and HODs to conduct the interview process effectively.

4.5.3.1. HR will coordinate with the applicant and the interview panel and schedule interview.

4.5.3.2. All candidates appearing for the interview have to fill in the Employment Application Form (Annexure 3)

4.5.3.3. Recruiter shall coordinate with the applicants and the interview panel to schedule the interview and block the calendar of the interview panel at least for an hour for interruption free interview process.

4.5.3.4. The Hiring Manager chairs the meeting and the panel should consist of a HR representative.

4.5.3.5. The Hiring Manager is the functional expert and is ultimately accountable for the success of the Talent Acquisition Process; they should provide clear guidance from the outset and functional support throughout the sourcing process.

4.5.3.6. The interview panel should ensure that the interview is being conducted in a very professional manner and only job-related questions are being asked. It is their responsibility to set a comfortable environment for the candidates to attend the interview with ease.

4.5.3.7. Interview assessment as required for the role, should be done based on Attitude, Skills and Functional/technical knowledge of the candidates.

4.5.3.8. The following cues shall be used by the interview panel to structure the interview.

a) Background interview questions: which reveal information about the applicant's education and professional experiences.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 4 Recruitment Process > 4.5 Interviewing
b) Behavioral interview questions: that focus on actual work incidents in the candidate's past, specific open-ended questions like 'tell us about an incident where you disciplined a team member'

c) Situational interview questions: hypothetical questions / scenarios that show how the candidate would react to or handle future situations / problem areas.

4.5.3.9. Panel should refrain from asking inappropriate questions that will discriminate or humiliate candidate's abilities or personality

4.5.3.10. Interviewing panel should assess the candidates in all the applicable areas as detailed Interview Assessment Form (Annexure 4).

4.5.3.11. The interviewing panel should document their feedback in the Interview Assessment Form and submit the form to HR with necessary recommendations.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 4 Recruitment Process > 4.5 Interviewing
Topic: 4.5.5 Modes of Interview
4.5.4.1. HR will coordinate with the interview panel and will choose appropriate mode of interview.

4.5.4.2. Interview shall be conducted in one or combination of the following modes depending upon the convenience of the interview panel and the candidate.

a) Face to face or in person interview (recommended)

b) Virtual through Zoom, Skype, Google meet, any other platform

c) Telephonic (only for preliminary screening)

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 4 Recruitment Process > 4.6 Selection
4.6.1. The Hiring Manager has the ultimate accountability for selecting the successful candidate. The final decision shall be made in the following order

4.6.1.1. Summarizing the information from the candidate assessment form of various candidates interviewed for the same role. What the candidate 'can do' factors include candidate's knowledge, skills and attitude and 'will-do' based on candidate's motivation and interests from the behavioral and situational assessment done.

4.6.1.2. Discussion with the HOD and HR for any inputs related to the cultural fitment.

4.6.1.3. Hiring manager shall finally select one candidate for the role and communicate to the HR

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 4 Recruitment Process > 4.7 Job Offer
4.7.1. HR prepares the Offer Proposal based on the below-mentioned critical attributes and gets the proposal approved by Head HR before extending to the candidates.

4.7.1.1. Academic & Professional qualification of the respective candidates

4.7.1.2. Experience Profile

4.7.1.3. Existing compensation and the candidate's expectation

4.7.1.4. Internal fitment for the role

4.7.2. HR after verifying their employment documents like salary slips, experience letters extend the proposal to the selected candidate and negotiates for closure of position. HR shall discuss the entire benefit scale of joining our organization with prospective candidate.

4.7.3. HR negotiates the offer with the selected candidate and releases the offer letter.

4.7.4. If the selected candidate rejects the offer, HR in consultation with the hiring manager and the HOD shall offer the job to the next best suitable candidate.

4.7.5. No candidate shall be issued a job offer without receiving the detail inputs and recommendation from the hiring manager and HOD on the interview assessment form.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 5 Turn Around Time (TAT)
5.1 It is the time taken by the HR to fill the position, calculated right from the date the position is approved to the date the candidate join the company.

5.2 TAT is based on the level of hiring as mentioned below.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy

Table: Turn Around Time (TAT) by hiring level
| Level | TAT (in days) |
| --- | --- |
| Junior | 40 |
| Middle | 70 |
| Senior | 100 |
| HOD & above | 100 |

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 6 Interview Etiquettes
6.1 Company respects the candidate's interest and the time for attending the interview.

6.2 It is the responsibility of the HR to ensure that every candidate who attends the interview with Pulse has a good experience irrespective of their selection or not.

6.3 The following etiquettes are to be practiced by the HR.

6.3.1. Interview schedule - date, time, location and travel directions should be shared with the candidate and the interview panel at least 3 days in advance.

6.3.2. Agreeing to genuine requests with strong reasons for postponing interviews

6.3.3. Interviews should start promptly as per the scheduled time.

6.3.4. All concerned staff - hiring team, front office, security should be informed about the interview schedules

6.3.5. Information should be given to candidates if there is are any delays / cancelations due to exigencies

6.3.6. Conference halls / venue should be blocked in advance for conducting the interviews.

6.3.7. All kinds of interruptions should be avoided during the interview

6.3.8. Introduce the panel members to the candidate

6.3.9. Allow the candidate to speak and ask questions

6.3.10. No negative, humiliating, derogating or sarcastic comment should be passed to the candidates

6.3.11. Inform the candidate on the next step of the process

6.3.12. Explain the administrative formalities such as travel claim etc.

6.3.13. Feedback to candidate about yes-no-hold decisions

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 7 Reimbursement for Outstation Interview Candidates
7.1 Company would reimburse the travel and accommodation expenses to the outstation candidates who are invited to attend the interview.

7.2 Candidate needs to submit a claim form to HR along with all supporting original bills for availing the reimbursement.

7.3 Eligibility, limit and other conditions will be applied as per the Travel and accommodation policy.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 8 Employment of immediate relatives or family members
8.1 This is a guideline to eliminate any kind of bias during the employment of immediate family members and relatives.

8.2 Any immediate family member or relative cannot be employed in a direct or indirect reporting relationship within the same process or within the same department.

8.3 In case of such employment, a deviation approval needs to be taken from the MD and Corporate Head-HR.

8.4 All the applicants will have to undergo formal interview process as laid down in this policy.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_recruitment_policy
Section: 9 Ex-Employee Rehire Guideline
9.1 Employees who get voluntarily separated from the Company in good standing; having successfully completed the probationary period; having provided appropriate notice of resignation; having participated in an exit interview, are eligible to apply only after 2 years of separation from the company.

9.2 All rehires will be treated as new employees with no service restoration/continuity.

9.3 All the applicants will have to undergo formal interview process as laid down in this policy.

9.4 The guideline is NOT applicable for employees leaving the company for reasons including misconduct, absenteeism, non-performance or voluntarily abandonment of service, or having a record of disciplinary issues regardless of the time that has passed.

9.5 The final decision of considering the application or selection is at the discretion of the Management.

Policy: Pulse Recruitment Policy (Version V.02, effective 2026-01-01)

Section: 10 Administration
